title: GLoot
summary: Inventory system: Inventory nodes with grid, weight, and stack-count limits, stackable items defined in a JSON prototree, item slots, and basic inventory UI.
useWhen: The game needs an inventory: picking up, stacking, splitting, and moving items between containers, a grid bag where items take several cells, a weight limit, equipment slots, or saving items to a file.
avoidWhen: A few fixed counters such as coins, keys, or ammo are enough; plain variables or a Dictionary are simpler.
